title: Compact-image finiteness with generic finite coefficients
statement: Let k be a field and Lambda a finite commutative ring whose exponent is invertible in k [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]. Let X and S be finite-type k-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and f:X -> S a morphism with a compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. If K is bounded constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], then Rf_!K is bounded constructible. For each Noetherian base change T -> S, its canonical compact-support exchange is an isomorphism. The coefficient ring need not be the prime field.

source.place: Compactification, extension by zero and proper finiteness; the adopted source gives the generic finite-coefficient version in CompactSupportBaseChange.lean.

proof.text: Choose the compactification f=pj. Its middle scheme is Noetherian because it is proper over the finite-type k-scheme S. Exact extension by zero sends the bounded constructible K to a bounded constructible complex, and proper direct-image finiteness sends this to a bounded constructible complex on S. This composite is the actual compact direct image.

proof.text: After any Noetherian base change, compute compact exchange in the base-changed compactification. It is the composite of proper base change and extension-by-zero base change, and each factor is an isomorphism. Canonical compactification comparison transports this to the canonical compact-support functors. This is precisely the existing proved source theorem boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerShriek_and_isIso.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerShriek_and_isIso {k : Type u} [Field k]
    [HasInvertibleExponent Λ (Spec (.of k))] {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [HasCompactification f] (aX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX] [LocallyOfFiniteType aS] [QuasiCompact aS]
    (_hf : f ≫ aS = aX)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (hK : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructible (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X K) :
    DerivedCategory.boundedConstructible (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) S
        ((R(f)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K) ∧
      ∀ (S' X' : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S'] (v : S' ⟶ S) (vX : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
        [HasCompactification f'] [QuasiCompact f'] (sq : IsPullback vX f' f v),
        IsIso ((rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq).app K)
